name: KIMS-NaI
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).

KIMS-NaI is recorded because the KIMS Collaboration published its own named programme and a limit paper (JHEP 03 (2019) 194); the sources treat it as the NaI(Tl) stage between KIMS-CsI and COSINE-100.

physics_goals.quote: The goal is to provide an unambiguous test of the DAMA/LIBRA's annual modulation signature.
physics_goals.value: Develop low-background NaI(Tl) crystals and test DAMA/LIBRA's modulation claim with the same target; planned 200 kg array

summary.plain: KIMS-NaI was the sodium-iodide stage of the Korean KIMS programme: the team grew its own low-radioactivity crystals, tested them underground at Yangyang and set dark-matter limits with two of them. A planned 200 kg array became, together with a US group, the COSINE-100 experiment.
summary.technical: NaI(Tl) crystal development and WIMP search at Y2L in the shield previously used for KIMS-CsI: two crystals (8.26 kg and 9.15 kg), 2967.4 kg d (November 2013 - January 2015), pulse-shape discrimination of nuclear recoils; limits partially exclude the DAMA/LIBRA allowed region for WIMP-sodium scattering. A 200 kg array was planned (arXiv:1510.04519).
